[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 40 (Hard, [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Spirit''' is the final boss of [[Frost Mode]]. It was also the final boss in Easy and Hard difficulty in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]], where it appeared Wave 25 at Easy difficulty and Wave 40 at Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]]. It moves at a very slow speed, however it possesses an high amount of health, and in [[Operation I.C.E Event]], an even higher health count than most other event bosses. Its health was boosted by 50% in ''True Form'' - a version which was activated in both Easy and Hard difficulty in [[Operation I.C.E Event]] through the Elite Token activation for the [[w:c:Roblox:Winter Spotlight|Roblox Winter Spotlight Event]]. The '''Frost Spirit''' has seven abilities, three of them can be used at any point, three of them are only used by it after entering its second phase and one which is its second phase activation: #The first ability is ''Frost Spikes'', where the '''Frost Spirit''' swings its scythe into the ground, creating a forward column of ice that freezes towers and units caught in it for 4 seconds, also dealing 1,600 damage to units. #Its second and last ability usable at any point is ''Summon'', where it slams its scythe down and raises its hand upwards, summoning nine enemies. These can be the [[Yeti]] (50% chance, 1.5 delay), [[Frostbane]] (35% chance, 0.75 delay) and [[Blizzard Wizard]] (15% chance, 1.5 delay). Each enemy has a 20% chance to be [[Bloated]]. #Its third ability is ''Antarctic Armageddon'', which happens at 80% health. This makes it fly up into the air, temporarily becoming [[Flying]] and losing [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] permanently, gaining a new appearance and then landing, creating a visual shockwave that does not stun towers or damage units. After this, it can use four more abilities. ##The first of these abilities is ''Ice Storm'', which makes it summon 120 icicles from the sky, which fall down and can stun towers and units, freezing them for 7.5 seconds and dealing 3,200 damage to units. ##The next ability is ''Ice Beacon'', which makes it summon three [[Ice Beacon]]s. These would heal the '''Frost Spirit''' by 4,500 every second while they were still on the path. They will be instantly killed when the '''Frost Spirit''' is at max health. During this ability, the '''Frost Spirit''' will become immobile and gain the [[No Target]] attribute. All damage dealt to it at that time will be redirected to the [[Ice Beacon]]s it has summoned, regardless if the tower actually hit them or not. ##The next ability is ''Switch Path'', where the '''Frost Spirit''' will jump to another path. This only works on maps with more than one path. ##The last ability is ''Laser Sweep'', which makes the '''Frost Spirit''' fire a laser beam from its face, sweeping it in a 360 degree arc, freezing every tower and unit caught in it for 6 seconds and dealing 1,000 damage to units. ##The last ability is its third phase, ''True Spirit'', which is triggered at 32% of its health. This will give it [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] permanently. ==Logbook Description== "''The Frost Spirit is one of the most powerful entities in the Frost Realm. Leading his own army, he commands all creatures under his domain. His followers fight unwaveringly for his cause as he demands absolute order and sacrifice to fulfill his desires. Once enraged, his arrack{{sic}} patterns change.''" ==Appearance== The '''Frost Spirit''' is an entity with purple skin with multiple dark purple veins on its body. On its right hand, it has blue fingers which it uses to hold its staff with. It wears a white robe, which has a fur outline around it and a hood, which covers most of its head other than its neon blue face. On its shoulders, multiple blue and purple thorns stick out, which are going through its robe. On its back, it has two purple and blue ice wings, which it uses to fly above the path during some of its abilities. Multiple chains are wrapped around its body and wings, with some being attached to the bands on its arms and torso. It also wears dark grey pants and grey shoes. It holds a giant scythe which it uses to perform some of its abilities. On top of its head, it has a blue halo. During ''Antarctic Armageddon'', its appearance will change. Most notably, its halo will turn purple and the crystals that form it will become uneven and bent. On its wings, the chains that surrounded it will be removed. Similarly, the collar it wears around its neck will disappear, though the chains connected to it will still remain there. Its walking animation will also change, with the easiest to spot change being its chains on its arms now swinging more as it moves. ==Strategy== *The '''Frost Spirit''' to a degree incorporates every detection into itself, meaning a variety of DPS towers is needed to kill it. **It at first spawns with [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]], meaning lead detection towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or bottom path [[Juggernaut]] are required. **Once it has reached 80% of its health, it will gain ''Switch Path'' and ''Ice Beacon'' abilities, the former making it a [[Flying]] enemy temporarily while the latter makes it summon three [[Flying]] enemies, meaning flying detection towers like [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]], top path [[Juggernaut]] or [[Kingpin]] can be used against these. **Once it has reached 32% of its health, it will become a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, meaning hidden detection towers like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Engineer]] or [[Juggernaut]] can be used. *Support towers like the [[Commander]], [[Medic]] and [[DJ Booth]] are extremely beneficial in buffing your towers. **Do note that the [[Medic]]'s shield cannot protect your towers from freezes, though its ''Ubercharge'' can give them [[Freeze Immunity]] temporarily. *As all of its abilities freeze, [[Stun Immunity]] has little use against it, though the [[Gatling Gun]] can still fire when frozen. **The [[Mercenary Base]]'s [[Field Medic]] can be used to protect units from being frozen or damaged, though do note there is a cooldown before it can be applied after it has been broken. *As the '''Frost Spirit''' has the [[Boss]] and [[Freeze Immunity]] attributes, it is heavily resistant or fully immune to most forms of stalling. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSpirit.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} OperationICEThumbnail.png|'''Frost Spirit''' on the game thumbnail. V2.8.0UpdateLog1.png|'''Frost Spirit''' on a [[v2.8.0]] update log image. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Frost Spirit''' is a returning boss from the [[Frost Invasion Event]]; awakened by [[Kronus (Narrator)|Master Kronus]] and the [[Children of Exo]] during the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] to attack ''T.D.S'', the fictional organization that the player is fighting for. **Its theme is a remix of the older [[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)|Frost Spirit]]'s theme. *The '''Frost Spirit''' has the most abilities out of every major boss in the entire game *The '''Frost Spirit''' is the second boss to be able to switch paths, with the first being [[Krampus (Krampus Frosthold)|Krampus]] from [[Krampus Frosthold]]. **The '''Frost Spirit''' is also the first evergreen [[enemy]] that is able to switch lanes via the ''Switch Path'' ability, the second being [[Voidling]], although it is unable to be seen outside of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *The '''Frost Spirit''' is the strongest [[Flying]] enemy when using the ''Switch Path'' ability or when entering its second phase, albeit only for a few seconds. *The shards that are required to unlock ''True Form'' are the '''Frost Spirit's''' halo based on the [[w:c:Roblox:Winter Spotlight|Winter Spotlight]] description. *The '''Frost Spirit''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''16 December 2024''' -
